name: cc-rsi
description: RSIAgent-style recursive self-improvement for Claude Code: an independent headless Verifier for your work, Actor-owned verified experience memory, and background Curriculum-driven exploration lineages (broad waves, deep target/practice, frozen reuse with sealed evaluation).

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) or full model id for the independent Verifier. Empty: the session's model.

stop_policy.title: Stop policy
stop_policy.description: off: never remind. nudge: remind once before finishing unverified or unlearned work. gate: block finishing unverified work up to 3 times.

sandbox.title: OS sandbox for role children
sandbox.description: auto: use the Claude Code sandbox when it works, otherwise degrade explicitly (shown at session start). require: refuse to run Verifier and lineage children without it. off: never use it.
